mapper.sql: SELECT a.id, a.asset_no, a.name, a.category_id, a.status, a.owner_dept_id, a.device_params, a.repair_cost, a.user_name, a.port_number, a.created_at, a.updated_at, c.name AS categoryName, d.name AS deptName FROM asset a LEFT JOIN category c ON a.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN department d ON a.owner_dept_id = d.id
mapper.select: ORDER BY a.asset_no COLLATE BINARY DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO asset (asset_no, name, category_id, status, owner_dept_id, device_params, repair_cost, user_name, port_number) VALUES (#{assetNo}, #{name}, #{categoryId}, #{status}, #{ownerDeptId}, #{deviceParams}, #{repairCost}, #{userName}, #{portNumber})
mapper.update: UPDATE asset SET asset_no = #{assetNo}, name = #{name}, category_id = #{categoryId}, owner_dept_id = #{ownerDeptId}, status = #{status}, device_params = #{deviceParams}, repair_cost = #{repairCost}, user_name = #{userName}, port_number = #{portNumber}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
